general-purpose subagent (Claude), separate context — confirmed reachability of the gauge-ordering finding through the overlapping-flush path in emitter.go/inflight.go

records.finding: biz_inflight_value (a level gauge) was Set in arrival order, ignoring p.At. emit's contract (emitter.go) says overlapping flushes may deliver batches out of order and consumers must order by At. A stale same-series sample arriving after a fresher one could overwrite the fresh level until the next publish. Reachable via background-ticker Flush racing a caller Flush; OTLP is immune because it stamps Time:p.At per datapoint, Prometheus text has no per-sample time.
records.reason: setInflight now records the last At applied per (flow,stage,age_bucket,currency) series under a mutex and drops any sample older than the one already published (equal At applies). Counters are untouched (Add commutes). Regression test TestInflightGaugeHonorsAtOrdering covers in-order, out-of-order, and equal-At cases; race-tested with -race.
